name: deepdev-erp-server
description: DeepDev ERP API (NestJS + PostgreSQL + Prisma + better-auth)

scripts.test:e2e: nest build && npm run test:db && node --env-file=.env.test --test --test-concurrency=1 --test-reporter=spec test/e2e/*.test.mjs
scripts.openapi: nest build && node -e "require('reflect-metadata');const {createApp,openApiDocument}=require('./dist/bootstrap');createApp().then(async a=>{await a.init();require('fs').writeFileSync('openapi.json',JSON.stringify(openApiDocument(a),null,2));await a.close();console.log('openapi.json written')})"
scripts.test:db: node --env-file=.env.test node_modules/prisma/build/index.js migrate deploy && node --env-file=.env.test --import tsx prisma/seed.ts
